mentions.name: ImperiaQuiz
mentions.description: Online multiplayer quiz game supporting 1-vs-1-vs-1 matches (with bot opponents when few players are online), a remake of the old ConQUIZtador game. Built with a Go backend, a React + Three.js frontend, and a bank of over 20,000 questions generated with LLMs and hand-reviewed.
mentions.source_excerpt:
An online quiz game https://imperiaquiz.com/en (1 vs 1 vs 1) or bots when there're not many online players. Go backend, React + Three frontend and a ton of questions (no API used there, I used LLMs and hand-reviews on many to fill up over 20,000 questions)

A remake of the old ConQUIZtador game.
mentions.author: xavortm
